scope: Continue mandatory final sweep while explicitly retaining draft/future-law signals.

records.result: Current 2026 policy signal is stronger than the earlier generic residual: officially published Beleidsregels woningsplitsing en woningdelen Gemeente Assen 2026 cover woningsplitsing, kamerverhuur and hospitaverhuur within mapped contours and include transition rules. This should be treated as current-law/policy evidence, with contour/address mapping remaining dynamic.

Current Beleidsregels kamerverhuur en woningsplitsing are confirmed effective from 13-12-2025 to present and explicitly connect both activities to an omgevingsvergunning for an omgevingsplanactiviteit. Generic current-policy uncertainty is closed; concrete property applicability remains Omgevingsplan/address dependent.

Current 2026 policy is positively confirmed. It explains how woningsplitsing and woningdelen/kamergewijze verhuur are assessed where the Omgevingsplan does not permit the activity. This removes any need to rely on legacy bestemmingsplan-era policy as the primary current source.

A 2026 current policy instrument explicitly covers woningsplitsing, kamerverhuur and woningdelen, including BOPA scope and activity-specific quality criteria. This is a useful current-law closure signal and replaces older uncertainty over whether woningdelen is separately covered.

An official ontwerp Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026 was published for consultation in October-November 2025 and explicitly proposed rules for verkamering/omzetting and opkoopbescherming. This is retained as a future-law signal. It must not be assumed to be current merely from the ontwerp publication; a follow-up search must establish whether and in what form it was adopted.
